name: PeerGarden
notes:
TESTING

No "groups" array, deliberately: traxary serves its own ladder from /api/user/groups (see the type def and GROUP_API_PLAN.md), so the ranks and their thresholds come from PeerGarden itself and cannot go stale between releases. The 10 autogroups this def used to carry were verified against that endpoint before removal — every threshold matched, which is the point: the def was right, it just had no way to stay right.
